clips.title: The story
paras: Kravel's Crate is a heavy package dispatched by Kravel Koalbeard from the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats. Destined for the Nesingwary expedition in Stranglethorn Vale, it contains specialized hunting ammunition designed to bring down the jungle's deadliest game.

Handed out by the shrewd entrepreneur Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway, Kravel's Crate represents an unfinished business transaction across continents. Ordered weeks prior by a wealthy dwarven patron, the shipment was delayed long enough for its buyer to depart Kalimdor entirely. Rather than lose out on the favor of a wealthy customer who already paid for forwarding, Kravel entrusts passing adventurers to haul the crate all the way to northern Stranglethorn Vale.

Despite its nondescript appearance and the crust of salt dust it gathers in the Shimmering Flats, the crate carries lethal cargo: heavy, special-gauge ammunition tailored specifically for hunting rifles. When received at the expedition camp north of Grom'gol, the recipient notes that the potent rounds are prized by big-game hunters and vital for survival against the predators roaming the jungle canopy.
